root.label: Iceland summons US ambassador over Trump's AI-generated map

events.label: Iceland summons US ambassador over Trump's AI-generated map

slots.name: date of summons
slots.sentence: Iceland summoned the US ambassador for talks last night after US president Donald Trump posted on social media an AI-generated map of the US, Canada and other countries, which appeared to include Iceland as the US territory.

slots.name: EU investment package amount
slots.sentence: The map also included Greenland as the US territory, despite being posted just hours after the EU unveiled a €200m investment package for the territory in an apparent attempt to strengthen its ties with the bloc (Europe Live, Monday).
